item.title: Norway Should Buy OpenAI
item.description:
📝 Public universities trained the PhDs. Clearly, the most transformative technology since agriculture should not be left in private hands. Perhaps this is an option that should be left open for a future administration, should Congress refuse to bring the labs into public hands themselves.

item.title: IndieWeb Homebrew Website Club Asia Pacific: Reflections
item.description:
📝 (Elsewhere: Mastodon)A recap and summary of the first ever Homebrew Website Club: Asia Pacific IndieWeb event. Tantek is one of the IndieWeb organizers, and he wrote a post about this incident if you want to read more about this incident. 😐 And what’s more, is actually another IndieWeb organizer received emails from this very same agent preceding HWC: AP for one of the IndieWeb Carnival events.
